products.textDetails: Learn photo editing, retouching and layer-based design from scratch with hands-on projects.
Create logos, icons and scalable artwork using the pen tool, shapes and color palettes.
Understand layout, typography and color systems to design clean and modern interfaces.
Build responsive designs, components and prototypes in Figma step by step.
Learn how to choose, pair and arrange fonts to make your designs readable and beautiful.
Design a complete brand identity including logo, colors, typography and style guide.
Bring your designs to life with basic animation principles and After Effects workflows.
